title: Juniper and the Drop
author: Casper Vane
blurb: Beatrix Halloran, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
